name: io.github.grkapoor17/semantic-warehouse-mcp
title: Semantic Warehouse
description: Guarded read-only SQL plus dbt semantic-layer metrics for AI agents, over a DuckDB warehouse.

packageArguments.name: --duckdb
packageArguments.description: Path to the DuckDB database file. It is always opened read-only.

packageArguments.name: --semantic-manifest
packageArguments.description: dbt's target/semantic_manifest.json. Adds list_metrics, list_dimensions and query_metrics.

packageArguments.name: --schemas
packageArguments.description: Comma-separated schemas the agent may list and query (enforced on every query), e.g. marts.
